title: Provide native-memory source records to enrolled thin clients
body:
A standard Aimee server returned 404 when an enrolled thinclient requested native-memory source records. This PR adds `POST /v1/native/primitive`: an authenticated, model-neutral personal-memory read that returns bounded selected records with their current revisions. The vLLM plugin uses the existing thinclient enrollment, fetches those records, and prepares model-specific native memory beside the model. The Aimee server does not download model weights or compute K/V tensors.

The change is limited to the server endpoint, its API contract, the generated route descriptor, and thinclient setup documentation. The older optional Unix-socket publication bridge and its export-policy code have been removed from this PR. The signed plugin executable is handled separately in PR #3002.

Validation against `testing`: Go memory and execution-policy package tests pass; the C `unit-test-server-http` route test passes; `docs-gen-check` and `git diff --check` pass. The separate private plugin validation previously exercised enrolled mTLS thinclient retrieval, GGUF-only Gemma4 12B local preparation and live vLLM consumption on an RTX 5080, including revocation. No release asset is published by this PR.
